name: AWTRIX NG
tagline: Next-gen ESP32 LED matrix clock firmware
description: AWTRIX NG is the next-generation firmware for ESP32-based LED matrix clocks, built by the creator of the original AWTRIX project. It turns a matrix of addressable LEDs into a highly capable, customizable smart clock with apps, notifications, and integrations. The project carries the heritage of the popular AWTRIX line (2k+ stars on GitHub) and modernizes it for today's ESP32 hardware, targeting makers who want a polished, self-hosted display for their desk or home.
highlights: Next-gen firmware from the original AWTRIX creator
Turns an ESP32 LED matrix into a customizable smart clock
Apps, notifications, and integrations for a self-hosted display
Carries the heritage of the 2k+ star AWTRIX project
curatorNote: The AWTRIX line has been a maker favorite for years; NG brings that momentum to modern ESP32 hardware and keeps the self-hosted ethos intact. A great entry point for anyone who wants a smart display without a cloud dependency.
